notes: Free core is genuinely capable. Advanced boards are paid features and are not assumed; the seeded administrator is the only account that exists before the opt-in sign-in relay provisions one per person (ADR-BE-22), and that path is not yet verified end to end. Runtime verified on 17.9.6: the published all-in-one image bundles PostgreSQL 17, memcached and the worker, so the definition is a single service and the container port is 80 (the canonical 8080 is the host side of the example mapping).
deviation: Native OIDC/SAML is Enterprise-gated (`sso_auth_providers`): measured on 17.9.6 with OPENPROJECT_EDITION=standard, the OmniAuth strategy is filtered at boot and no provider can be signed in with, so the free core runs behind the proxy gate. The gate protects the route; it does not sign anyone in. ADR-BE-22 adds an opt-in relay that may sign a person in afterwards, and the class stays `fa_gate` either way. ADR-BE-15 records the flip to native OIDC once a token exists.
